verdict.rationale: New Relic ships a built-in AI assistant (New Relic AI) that lets users ask questions, troubleshoot issues, explore telemetry in plain language and get help writing queries. A vulnerability-management agent goes beyond Q&A: it triages CVEs, drafts remediation steps and can open Jira or GitHub issues, which is real task delegation. Missing for 10: documentation of the breadth of tasks the assistant can carry out beyond Q&A and CVE triage, substantiation of the 'automated remediation' claim beyond a marketing tagline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
